dataset: India government jobs — official portal snapshot
description: A dated, curated snapshot of active India government-job notices found on primary official portals. It is not an exhaustive guarantee of every vacancy on the internet; applicants should confirm the complete advertisement, eligibility, dates and application process at the official source before applying.
coverageNote: Official-source coverage only. This snapshot includes the seven active ISRO notice rows below and selected official discovery hubs; it does not claim complete coverage of all central, state or public-sector vacancies.
sourceHubNote: Some official portals require JavaScript or do not expose a structured feed in this static snapshot. The hub links are provided for direct checking and broader discovery.
classificationNote: Rank and category are WILSY display and browsing fields, not official merit lists, appointment grades or vacancy counts.

sourceHubs.name: National Career Service — government jobs
sourceHubs.note: Official government-job search hub; the portal may require JavaScript and has no structured feed exposed to this static snapshot.

sourceHubs.name: UPSC recruitment advertisements
sourceHubs.note: Official Union Public Service Commission recruitment hub; check the live advertisement for each notice.

sourceHubs.name: SSC candidates
sourceHubs.note: Official Staff Selection Commission candidate hub; some content and notices are presented through JavaScript-driven pages.

sourceHubs.name: RRB Apply
sourceHubs.note: Official Railway Recruitment Boards application hub; application availability and notice details should be checked live.

sourceHubs.name: India Post vacancies
sourceHubs.note: Official India Post vacancies hub; portal structure can change and may not provide a structured feed here.

sourceHubs.name: Employment News
sourceHubs.note: Official Employment News portal; use the live issue and linked recruiting authority notice for complete details.

sourceHubs.name: ISRO current opportunities
sourceHubs.note: Official ISRO current-opportunities hub; the page is the discovery source for the active ISRO notices in this snapshot.
